translations.web: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
translations.bsb: You, O LORD, will keep us; You will forever guard us from this generation.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
translations.asv: Thou wilt keep them, O Jehovah, Thou wilt preserve them from this generation for ever.
